backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (CommentList, AppEvent, ChatMessage, ImageMeta, Settings) and CRUD operations for a comment/event management app, including template usage tracking, image storage, chat messages, and settings management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single implemented feature: removing the App/Event dropdown from the Single Comment Generator in UserView.tsx so users see all unlocked comment lists directly.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key functionality of each component, view, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering colors for background, foreground, cards, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing the app shell with background music control, a countdown timer, floating decorative shapes, four-tab navigation (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin), and a sticky header with settings integration.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin authentication gate component that renders a password input form accepting a 4-digit code and delegates unlock logic to the useAdminAuth hook.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: Component for generating multiple comments at once from a selected comment list, gated behind an access key, with quantity selection, scrollable output, and a copy-all button.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: Renders an SVG donut chart showing the percentage of used templates out of total templates, with a gradient arc and centered percentage text.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots at enemies by clicking, and tracks score and time until game over.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that lets users type and submit a comment via the `useAddChatMessage` mutation hook, displaying loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded PIN code, persisting the unlocked status in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Controls background music playback via an HTML Audio element, supporting play/pause toggling based on a provided URL and enabled flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides utility functions to generate single or bulk random comments by picking templates from a `CommentList` and optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device ID in localStorage, returning it as a stable string.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity state, and login status, built on top of the DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including comment lists, available counts, list metrics, apps/events, chat messages, images, and settings. Also exports local claim helpers for device-locked comment generation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a dark neon theme, and provides utility classes like glass-card, gradient-heading, and neon-text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Utility that generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone-specific adjectives and phrase banks across categories (performance, UI, features, support) with variable length suffixes.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: Admin panel tab for generating comment templates locally based on topic, tone, and count, then selectively adding chosen templates to an existing comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat component that displays a scrollable list of timestamped messages fetched from the backend and allows sending new messages, with auto-refresh every 5 seconds.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin panel for managing comment lists: creating lists, adding templates via textarea, toggling list lock state, and viewing per-list metrics with a donut chart.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin image management view that provides a file upload form with name/tags input, upload progress tracking, and displays the existing image gallery.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin view for managing app/event username lists, supporting creating events, adding or bulk-uploading usernames, inline renaming, deletion, and a username membership checker across multiple events.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page component that allows toggling background music, uploading a music file with progress tracking, and managing (viewing, setting, or regenerating) the access key used for the Bulk Comments Generator.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that gates access behind admin auth, renders a horizontal tab bar (Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, Settings), and conditionally renders the corresponding sub-view based on the active tab.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: View component that lets users check whether a list of usernames exists within selected app/event lists, displaying found/not-found results with expandable per-app breakdowns.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: View component providing three upload workflows: single comment upload, bulk comment generation, file-based template upload to a comment list, and image upload to the backend.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: Main customer-facing view that lets users select a comment list, generate a random comment (with one-per-device locking via localStorage), copy it to clipboard, and includes a TopDownShooter game component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk), oklch-based color tokens, neon box shadows, border radius variants, and keyframe animations (fade-in, pulse-neon, accordion).
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 15) documenting the app's architecture, existing features, known issues, and high-level summary for an App Content & Feedback Manager with admin panel, AI templates, live checker, bulk comments, and background music.
